content: {"rule": "K-G4", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text treats the cited verse Luke 2:48-49 as answered, which is exactly the situation the rule governs.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D4 vs C2 (Luke 2:48-49): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"", "rule_words": "A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.", "room": "none", "why": "Because the judge says Luke 2:48-49 was answered, the rule requires that it not be counted as an unanswered witness, and the text does not count it."}
